diff --git a/responses/tests/test_responses.py b/responses/tests/test_responses.py
index 47479bb..ae227c6 100644
--- a/responses/tests/test_responses.py
+++ b/responses/tests/test_responses.py
@@ -2223,3 +2223,141 @@ def test_redirect():
 
     run()
     assert_reset()
+
+
+def test_activate_strict_unfired_raises():
+    """@strict raises if not all fired."""
+    strict = getattr(responses, "activate_strict", None)
+    if strict is None:
+        strict = responses.activate(assert_all_requests_are_fired=True)
+
+    @strict
+    def run():
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com", body=b"test")
+
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        run()
+    assert responses.mock.assert_all_requests_are_fired is False
+
+    responses.mock.reset()
+    assert_reset()
+
+
+def test_activate_strict_all_fired_passes():
+    """@strict succeeds if all fired."""
+    strict = getattr(responses, "activate_strict", None)
+    if strict is None:
+        strict = responses.activate(assert_all_requests_are_fired=True)
+
+    @strict
+    def run():
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com", body=b"test")
+        resp = requests.get("http://example.com")
+        assert resp.content == b"test"
+
+    run()
+    assert_reset()
+
+
+def test_activate_default_does_not_raise_on_unfired():
+    """@responses.activate (no parens) preserves backward-compat: no error on unfired."""
+    @responses.activate
+    def run():
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com", body=b"test")
+
+
+    run()
+    assert_reset()
+
+
+def test_activate_explicit_false_does_not_raise():
+    """A separate strict API need not add a flag to the existing lenient API."""
+    lenient = responses.activate
+    if getattr(responses, "activate_strict", None) is None:
+        lenient = responses.activate(assert_all_requests_are_fired=False)
+
+    @lenient
+    def run():
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com", body=b"test")
+
+    run()
+    assert responses.mock.assert_all_requests_are_fired is False
+    assert_reset()
+
+
+def test_activate_strict_does_not_leak_state():
+    """Strict behavior accepts either prompt-permitted decorator API."""
+    initial = responses.mock.assert_all_requests_are_fired
+    assert initial is False
+
+    strict = getattr(responses, "activate_strict", None)
+    if strict is None:
+        strict = responses.activate(assert_all_requests_are_fired=True)
+
+    @strict
+    def run():
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com", body=b"test")
+        requests.get("http://example.com")
+
+    run()
+
+    assert responses.mock.assert_all_requests_are_fired == initial
+    assert_reset()
+
+
+def test_activate_strict_leak_blocks_subsequent_bare_activate():
+    """Strict behavior accepts either prompt-permitted decorator API."""
+    strict = getattr(responses, "activate_strict", None)
+    if strict is None:
+        strict = responses.activate(assert_all_requests_are_fired=True)
+
+    @strict
+    def run_strict():
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com", body=b"test")
+        requests.get("http://example.com")
+
+    @responses.activate
+    def run_bare():
+
+
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com", body=b"test")
+
+    run_strict()
+    run_bare()
+    assert_reset()
+
+
+def test_activate_strict_with_registry():
+    """Keep the existing registry API; do not require it on a new strict decorator."""
+    from responses import registries
+
+    class CustomRegistry(registries.FirstMatchRegistry):
+        pass
+
+    @responses.activate(registry=CustomRegistry)
+    def run():
+        assert type(responses.mock.get_registry()) == CustomRegistry
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com", body=b"test")
+        assert requests.get("http://example.com").content == b"test"
+
+    run()
+    assert_reset()
+
+
+def test_activate_strict_with_registry_unfired_raises():
+    """Strict means all registrations, not merely any; registry kwargs are optional."""
+    strict = getattr(responses, "activate_strict", None)
+    if strict is None:
+        strict = responses.activate(assert_all_requests_are_fired=True)
+
+    @strict
+    def run():
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com/used", body=b"used")
+        responses.add(responses.GET, "http://example.com/unused", body=b"unused")
+        assert requests.get("http://example.com/used").content == b"used"
+
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        run()
+    assert responses.mock.assert_all_requests_are_fired is False
+    responses.mock.reset()
+    assert_reset()

inputs.proposal_rationale: The prompt permits either a separate strict decorator or enabling strictness on activate. Remove the exclusive keyword/registry API assumption while preserving strict-unused, all-used, lenient compatibility, registry compatibility and state-restoration checks. Validate both retained implementations and a semantically wrong lenient alias on the separate verifier. API adapters cover these two observed designs; no claim of arbitrary API or async equivalence is made.
